metas.name: Hushar Pittalu
metas.description: In a village, two teenagers fall into a secret relationship, driven by curiosity and bad influences. As their families oppose them, the couple rebels, exposing how youthful attraction and parental mistakes can change lives forever.

metas.name: Modha Rathiri
metas.description: Follows two strangers brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.

metas.name: Kadaisi Vivasayi
metas.description: The last active farmer in a remote village tries to hold out against a property developer.

metas.name: Thevar Magan
metas.description: The urbane son of a village chieftain struggles between his personal aspirations and those of his family.

metas.name: Methagu
metas.description: The true events that happened in Tamileelam to suppress Tamil ethnicity and why Tamil leader Prabhakaran emerged in the Tamil freedom struggle in the Indian Ocean Island nation Srilanka.

metas.name: Aaranya Kaandam
metas.description: A mob boss must deal with a disgruntled mistress and a vanishing bag of cocaine.

metas.name: Mudhalvan
metas.description: A man accepts a challenge to act as the Chief Minister for one day only, and makes such a success of it that soon he is embroiled in political intrigue.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes, while the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: Casino
metas.description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

metas.name: Ghamasaan
metas.description: A cat-and-mouse tale set in the Hindi heartland, where male friendships and rivalries unveil homoerotic tensions. Men on both sides of the law traverse arid lands, creating a sense of place where unexplored histories reside.

metas.name: Rush
metas.description: James Hunt and Niki Lauda, two extremely skilled Formula One racers, have an intense rivalry with each other. However, it is their enmity that pushes them to their limits.

metas.name: Thuppakki
metas.description: An army captain is on a mission to track down and destroy a terrorist gang and deactivate the sleeper cells under its command.

metas.name: Haider
metas.description: A young man returns to Kashmir after his father's disappearance to confront his uncle, whom he suspects of playing a role in his father's fate.

metas.name: Manjhi: The Mountain Man
metas.description: Using only a hammer and a chisel, a man spends twenty-two years carving a road through a treacherous mountain.

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

metas.name: Por Thozhil
metas.description: A bright but faint-hearted rookie cop has to overcome his fears in order to succeed in his first case which sees him partnered with a reclusive senior officer to catch a serial killer on the loose.

metas.name: Ko
metas.description: Ashwin, a famous photographer, works with Renuka, an investigative journalist. When one of their colleagues, Saro, gets killed during a political meet, Ashwin and Renuka decide to investigate.

metas.name: Dor
metas.description: Two woman --different backgrounds, miles apart, and strangers to each other-- are linked by tragedy. Their new-found friendship is tested as one holds the fate of the other's husband in her hands.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: Baron "Bear" Bailey breaks a novelty charm to force his co-worker Nikki Freeman to love him, but the supernatural compulsion warps her mind into violent obsession, trapping him in a nightmare he cannot wish away.

metas.name: Karthikeya 2
metas.description: A sequel to Karthikeya (2014), which deals with the personal problems of Karthikeya and how his pursuit of the truth leads him to find out the power of Indian ancient system and Tatva of Lord Sri Krishna.

metas.name: Shrek
metas.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

metas.name: Friends
metas.description: Three friends, who value friendship over everything else, begin to fall apart when one of them learns about a shocking incident that happened in their past.

metas.name: Baby
metas.description: An elite counter-intelligence unit learns of a plot, masterminded by a maniacal madman. With the clock ticking, it's up to them to track the terrorists' international tentacles and prevent them from striking at the heart of India.

metas.name: Mumbai Police
metas.description: ACP Antony is the only one who knows the truth behind ACP Aaryan's murder. Antony meets with an accident, losing his memory and is unable to reveal the killer. He is forced to investigate the murder again hoping that he remembers ...

metas.name: Rekhachithram
metas.description: Suspended cop Vivek Gopinath rejoins after gambling scandal. Tasked with solving 40-year-old murder case with faceless victim, he seeks redemption by cracking the long-unsolved mystery.

metas.name: Rockstar
metas.description: Janardhan Jakhar chases his dreams of becoming a big Rock star, during which he falls in love with Heer.

metas.name: Hidden Figures
metas.description: Three female African-American mathematicians play a pivotal role in astronaut John Glenn's launch into orbit while dealing with racial and gender discrimination.

metas.name: Mimi
metas.description: Mimi is introduced by Bhanu to an American couple as a surrogate in exchange for Rs 2 million. She decides to have the baby even when they change their mind and tells her parent that Bhanu is the father.

metas.name: Iratta
metas.description: After a cop is found dead, a policeman's investigation sparks a chilling search for the truth connected to his estranged twin and their fraught past.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: Danny Ocean, a gangster, rounds up a gang of associates to stage a sophisticated and elaborate casino heist which involves robbing three Las Vegas casinos simultaneously during a popular boxing event.

metas.name: Primal Fear
metas.description: A high-profile murder intrigues a publicity hungry lawyer.

metas.name: A Few Good Men
metas.description: A military lawyer intends to prove that two US Marines charged with murdering a fellow Marine were only following their base commander's orders.

metas.name: G.D.N
metas.description: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
metas.description: An orphaned boy enrolls in a school of wizardry, where he learns the truth about himself, his family and the terrible evil that haunts the magical world.

metas.name: Delhi Belly
metas.description: Three struggling room-mates unknowingly become potential prey of a ruthless gangster.

metas.name: Deool Band 2
metas.description: The story follows a farmer who decides to question and test his faith, setting off a journey filled with emotional and life-altering moments. At its core, the narrative centers on a woman who tirelessly struggles for her family, facing hardships with resilience, as her path ultimately leads her to confront the very idea of divine power

metas.name: Sinners
metas.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

metas.name: Rakkasapuradhol
metas.description: Inspector Shiva an alcoholic officer struggling with schizophrenia, is transferred to Rakkasapura, a seemingly quiet village with a low crime rate. Soon The village’s peace is shattered by a series of gruesome murders. Young women are found dead, dressed in bridal finery with their faces charred beyond recognition. Witness as a troubled cop in rural India confronts his own demons while pursuing a complex case that tests his moral boundaries and beliefs.

metas.name: Dil Se..
metas.description: A radio broadcaster's intense attraction to a mysterious woman opens the door to a tidal wave of powerful emotions and desires.

metas.name: Promising Young Woman
metas.description: An unexpected encounter gives a wickedly smart woman a chance to right the wrongs from the past.

metas.name: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
metas.description: An NRI and his wife decide to stay in his ancestral home, paying no heed to the warnings about ghosts. Soon, inexplicable occurrences cause him to call a psychiatrist to help solve the mystery.

metas.name: Chup
metas.description: A lonesome florist with a new-found love interest and a psychopath killer who targets film critics in Mumbai. Are the two related? Inspector Arvind Mathur and Dr. Zenobia are about to find out.

metas.name: Miss Lovely
metas.description: A Hindi feature film set in the lower depths of Bombay's "C" grade film industry. Miss Lovely follows the devastating story of two brothers who produce sleazy horror films in the mid-1980s.

metas.name: Nocturnal Animals
metas.description: A wealthy art gallery owner is haunted by her ex-husband's novel, her memories of their relationship, and her regrets about her life.

metas.name: Weapons
metas.description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

metas.name: Anora
metas.description: A young stripper from Brooklyn meets and impulsively marries the son of a Russian oligarch. Once the news reaches Russia, her fairy tale is threatened as his parents set out for New York to get the marriage annulled.
